hipotese: The modelo_v3 pipeline (GNN and MLP), on the CANONICAL dataset (enriched_cftudo), run 2 times with the SAME training seed (42) and the SAME split_seed (42), without chain, 8 epochs, produces the SAME per-population MAE number between the 2 repetitions (effective training determinism on this GPU/driver), within a numerical-floor tolerance.
predicao: If the hypothesis is true, the absolute divergence between repetition 1 and repetition 2 in the per-population MAE (rssi_dbm, path_loss_total_dB and the other reported channels) is <= 1e-3 dB, for both GNN and MLP, in Bauru Q1 and in Lins Q1.
criterio_aceite: PASS if |MAE_rep1 - MAE_rep2| <= 1e-3 dB in ALL 4 combinations (bauru-GNN, bauru-MLP, lins-GNN, lins-MLP); FAIL (branch declared in the protocol) if any combination diverges by > 1e-3 dB -- in that case every modelo_v3 number becomes a per-seed distribution and the article text declares non-determinism instead of a point value. Indeterminate (budget exhausted before completing the 8 runs) = abortado_por_orcamento, with no PASS/FAIL conclusion on the hypothesis.
condicao_de_lancamento: launched only if gpu/A2c/controle_cftudo_bauru_Q1.json (GNN and MLP, Bauru Q1, cftudo, same config) shows sentinel MAE_rssi < 1 dB and valid < 5 dB for both models (item (2)/(3) of the deliverable); otherwise the batch stays on hold and the diagnosis is recorded without launching a run.
gravidade: divergence > 1e-3 dB in any combination = finding that changes the article text (distribution per seed instead of a point value); it does not by itself block the roadmap -- it is the very exit question of this block
dado: ACTUAL Bauru Q1 and Lins Q1, CANONICAL dataset enriched_cftudo (whole graph, --mmap, without --max-nodes), GPU RTX 5070 Ti (~8.4 GB free at the start of this round; concurrent embedding engine; abort the run if free VRAM < 1 GB)
